_about: Maps each multi-agent orchestration track to the repository its worktree-isolated agents must be provisioned in. This is the 'track -> repo root' map.
_bug_this_prevents: The Workflow engine's isolation:'worktree' option cuts each agent's worktree from the SESSION's own git repo (the CWD the Workflow process was launched from). There is NO per-call repo override in the agent() API (options are label/phase/schema/model/isolation/agentType only). On 2026-05-30 the orchestration session ran from /Users/colin/Code/addiction (remote digitalharm/addiction-research, a Next.js site) instead of fight-csam, so ALL 10 wave A/B/C impl agents got a worktree of the WRONG repo. The corrected wave scripts no longer rely on the session CWD: a preflight agent reads the constants below, asserts repo identity, and provisions worktrees explicitly via `git -C <repoRoot>`.
_runtime_note: Workflow scripts cannot read files at runtime (no fs/require). When you change this config you MUST also update the baked-in constants at the top of the corrected scripts in ./scripts/. This JSON is the source of truth those constants are copied from.

fight-csam._markerFiles_note: Paths that MUST exist under repoRoot. Cargo.toml + packages/ are present in fight-csam and absent in addiction-research — this is the discriminator the preflight asserts on.

worktreeNaming._reconcile_note: This is the canonical scheme going forward. Some pre-existing worktrees use an older bare name (e.g. .worktrees/wave-c-trainguard, .worktrees/wave-b-promptshield). The preflight provisioner detects a branch already attached to ANY worktree path (via `git worktree list --porcelain`) and REUSES it rather than creating a duplicate, so the two schemes coexist without collision.
